# ClosedLoopNeuromorphicControl

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A control paradigm where spiking neural network outputs are fed back into the system to continuously adjust motor or sensory commands based on current neural state. Critical for deploying neuromorphic hardware in real-world tasks requiring online error correction and adaptive behavior.
